title: Demonstrating Feasibility of Using a Robot to Deliver a Multicomponent Intervention to Reduce Delirium Occurrence in Hospitalized Elderly Subjects at Risk of Delirium
official: Demonstrating Feasibility of Using a Robot to Deliver a Multicomponent Intervention to Reduce Delirium Occurrence in Hospitalized Elderly Subjects at Risk of Delirium
summary: This is a feasibility study. 20 non-ICU hospitalized patients at high risk of getting delirium will be consented and screened to receive a personalized multicomponent non-pharmacological intervention through an autonomous navigating robot at the bedside.

interventions.name: personalized multicomponent non-pharmacological intervention through an autonomous mobile robot to prevent delirium

criteria:
Inclusion criteria: High risk of delirium: Agr \>80, dementia, High readmission risk score as calculated by EPIC, postoperative

Exclusion Criteria: Patients who screen positive for delirium by CAM Patients who are actively dying Patients who cannot perform the CAM due to language or advanced dementia or level of consciousness
